title: Decision: logging outputs to stderr not stdout
description: init_logging() directs all tracing output to std::io::stderr, not stdout. This is correct for a daemon: stdout may be consumed by a process supervisor or pipe, and mixing log lines with any structured output on stdout would corrupt both. Systemd's journal captures stderr from services automatically. The TTY-vs-JSON format selection also keys off stderr's is_terminal(), which correctly reflects whether the daemon is running attached to a terminal or under systemd.
